WasteSort candidate-pair review

Goal Diggers · 45 automated similarity candidates. This gallery is not a completed human audit.

All candidate groups already stay within one partition. The published test set has been evaluated: do not change its labels or membership and report the revised score as if it used an untouched test set. Record review findings for a separately versioned study. Keep uncertain cases marked uncertain.

Images: TrashNet by Gary Thung and Mindy Yang. See THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md for the source MIT notice. The gallery embeds thumbnails and works offline. It does not save decisions or transmit data.
